decisions.reason: The multiple-format decision concerns editable source-file formats and does not change the required fonts, icons, design assets, or their future-editing purpose.
Requiring multiple editable file formats does not alter which customer-specific fields must remain editable or how those fields are displayed.
The delivery-format correction does not change the required report identifiers or their consistency across report versions.
The source message changes the required editable delivery formats, not the content or presentation of the front-page result explanation.
The requirement for multiple editable formats does not modify footer presentation or page coverage.
File-format selection does not change the mapping between report variants and exposure bands.
The source decision concerns source-file formats and leaves the dashboard fields, prominence, heading, and visual treatment unchanged.
The requirement to deliver multiple editable formats does not alter internal-page header content, style, or scope.
The source message corrects the handoff format only and does not revise the accepted visual style or refinement priorities.
The multiple-format requirement does not change any risk-profile-specific report wording.
The source-file format correction does not affect the confidentiality warning's presence, wording, visual treatment, or footer interaction.
